Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

banditlab 0.1.0

Initial CRAN release.

  • scale_colour_banditlab() and scale_fill_banditlab() work with ggplot2 versions both before and after 3.5.0 (older versions require scale_name in ggplot2::discrete_scale()).
  • New website article, “Bandits for RAN optimisation: 5G NR link adaptation”, comparing bandit policies with a static CQI rule and outer-loop link adaptation in simulated stationary and drifting radio conditions.
  • Environments: bandit_bernoulli(), bandit_gaussian(), bandit_custom().
  • Policies: policy_random(), policy_greedy() (optimistic initial values via initial_value), policy_epsilon_greedy() (fixed epsilon or a schedule function), policy_etc(), policy_ucb1(), policy_thompson().
  • run_experiment(): replicated experiments with one L’Ecuyer-CMRG stream per replicate; results are independent of the number of replicates run and seed-paired across policies.
  • Results: per-replicate summaries, optional checkpoints, optional full trajectories with logged marginal propensities; summary(), as_tibble(), compare_policies(), autoplot().
  • Regret metrics with exact definitions in ?regret_definitions; metrics are NA when the environment’s expected rewards are unknown.
  • Extension API: policy_state(), select_arm(), update_state(), documented in vignette("custom-policies") and exercised by a policy implemented outside the package in the test suite.
  • Visualisation: autoplot() now applies theme_banditlab() (clean typography hierarchy, horizontal-only gridlines) and a fixed-order, 7-hue accessible palette (scale_colour_banditlab() / scale_fill_banditlab(), aliased as scale_color_banditlab()) by default. The palette is derived from Okabe and Ito’s categorical set, checked programmatically for lightness, chroma, simulated colour-vision-deficiency separation and contrast rather than chosen by eye (black excluded and reserved as ink; yellow deepened for legibility on white). Plot titles and axis labels name every metric in full (for example “Cumulative pseudo-regret”, “Decision step”). Identity is never colour-alone: line plots also vary linetype and the arm-share plot also varies bar position. Requesting more than seven policies in one autoplot() call errors with guidance rather than falling back silently to a non-accessible palette.

Developed by Mubanga Nsofu.
